title: Certain inputs escape the godot game window
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot 4.8 dev 7
Not Reproducible in: Godot 4.7 stable

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev7 - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (2560x1600 @ 165.00 Hz) - Kernel: x86_64 Linux 7.2.5-200.fc44.x86_64 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7700S (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 35.12 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When launching the game window in the 'floating window' mode (both with and without the toolbar), certain keys will 'escape containment' and bent to the last selected window in the Godot Engine.

The only key presses that 'pass-through' from the game to the editor are 'Q', 'W', 'E', 'R', and 'G'. Additionally, when these characters escape, in text editors they are entered as capitals, despite shift and caps lock not being enabled.

The attached video shows what occurs when the cursor was last selected on the 'Filter Files' text edit line (in the bottom left), but it should be noted that this occurs in all windows & text editors, like the script editor. Another example, when in the 3D editor, the 'W' and 'E' keys will sometimes be registered as held down (causing the camera to fly forward and up when you hold right click to move it) and additionally 'E' will switch to the rotate tool/gizmo.

I strongly suspect this bug is resulting from one of the changes to the new embedded game window.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16abb26f-357f-459d-928c-cfd343c84c24

### Steps to reproduce

Launch the game in 'floating window' mode (with or without the toolbar; occurs in both cases

Press q, w, e, r, or g and the last selected window in the godot editor will recieve the input.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Literally any project
